# Spray Foam Rig Insurance

> Spray Foam Rig Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for spray foam contractors' rigs and equipment in all 50 states. Coverage lines: inland marine for rigs and equipment, equipment breakdown, business auto for rig trucks, theft and vandalism, replacement cost coverage, general liability, workers' compensation, and contractors pollution liability. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [Inland Marine — Rig & Equipment](/services/inland-marine): Proportioners, hose, spray guns, and trailers covered on the job, in transit, and in storage.
- [Equipment Breakdown](/services/equipment-breakdown): When the proportioner or heated hose fails mid-job — repair, replacement, and the downtime that follows.
- [Business Auto — Rig Trucks](/services/commercial-auto): The box truck or trailer-hauling vehicle that moves the rig to every job.
- [Theft & Vandalism](/services/theft-protection): Off-trailer, off-jobsite, and in-transit theft of rigs, drums, and equipment.
- [Replacement Cost Coverage](/services/replacement-cost): Pays what a new rig actually costs rather than a depreciated value.
- [General Liability](/services/general-liability): Premises, operations, and jobsite exposure for spray foam rig operations.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Applicator and rig-operator injuries with the correct class codes.
- [Contractors Pollution Liability](/services/contractors-pollution-liability): Isocyanate exposure, overspray, and off-ratio application claims.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **spray foam rigs and equipment** (proportioners, heated hose, rig trucks, drums) — not general contractor coverage.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
